name: bentbound
description: Bent & Bound e-commerce management system – Next.js client + Express/PostgreSQL API

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run worker:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web "npm start --prefix server" "npm run worker --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
